parts.name: fold_base

parts.name: fold_wing_north

parts.name: fold_wing_south

parts.orientation: Cara amplia ya apoyada; revisar puentes de bisagra

parts.supports: no previstos; revisar puentes y primera capa

parts.name: hinge_axle

parts.name: lock_key
